panels.description: Synthèse pédagogique du contexte macro. 0 à -1 : contexte respirable ; -2 à -3 : prudence ; <= -4 : risk-off marqué. Ce score ne déclenche aucun trade.

targets.queryText:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT value FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'VIX' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS vix,
        (SELECT value FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'USD_BROAD' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS usd_broad,
        (SELECT value FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'US10Y' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS us10y,
        (
            SELECT us10y.value - us2y.value
            FROM macro_series us10y
            JOIN macro_series us2y
              ON us2y.observed_at = us10y.observed_at
            WHERE us10y.source = 'fred'
              AND us2y.source = 'fred'
              AND us10y.symbol = 'US10Y'
              AND us2y.symbol = 'US2Y'
            ORDER BY us10y.observed_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS spread_10y_2y,
        (SELECT value FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'WTI' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS wti,
        (SELECT value FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'BRENT' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS brent,
        (SELECT value FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'SP500' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS sp500_latest,
        (
            SELECT value
            FROM macro_series
            WHERE source = 'fred'
              AND symbol = 'SP500'
              AND observed_at <= date(
                  (SELECT MAX(observed_at) FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'SP500'),
                  '-30 days'
              )
            ORDER BY observed_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS sp500_30d,
        (SELECT value FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'NASDAQ' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS nasdaq_latest,
        (
            SELECT value
            FROM macro_series
            WHERE source = 'fred'
              AND symbol = 'NASDAQ'
              AND observed_at <= date(
                  (SELECT MAX(observed_at) FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'NASDAQ'),
                  '-30 days'
              )
            ORDER BY observed_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS nasdaq_30d
)
SELECT
    (CASE WHEN vix >= 20 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN vix >= 30 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN usd_broad >= 122 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN us10y >= 5 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN spread_10y_2y < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN wti >= 90 OR brent >= 90 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN sp500_30d IS NOT NULL AND sp500_latest < sp500_30d THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
  + (CASE WHEN nasdaq_30d IS NOT NULL AND nasdaq_latest < nasdaq_30d THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
    AS "Score macro"
FROM latest;

panels.description: Détail des huit règles composant le score macro v1. Un impact de -1 indique qu'une règle de prudence est active.

        (
            SELECT value
            FROM macro_series
            WHERE source = 'fred'
              AND symbol = 'SP500'
              AND observed_at <= date(
                  (SELECT MAX(observed_at) FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'SP500'),
                  '-30 days'
              )
            ORDER BY observed_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS sp500_30d,
        (SELECT value FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'NASDAQ' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS nasdaq_latest,
        (
            SELECT value
            FROM macro_series
            WHERE source = 'fred'
              AND symbol = 'NASDAQ'
              AND observed_at <= date(
                  (SELECT MAX(observed_at) FROM macro_series WHERE source = 'fred' AND symbol = 'NASDAQ'),
                  '-30 days'
              )
            ORDER BY observed_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS nasdaq_30d
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN sp500_30d IS NOT NULL AND sp500_30d <> 0
             THEN ((sp500_latest / sp500_30d) - 1.0) * 100.0 END AS sp500_perf_30d,
        CASE WHEN nasdaq_30d IS NOT NULL AND nasdaq_30d <> 0
             THEN ((nasdaq_latest / nasdaq_30d) - 1.0) * 100.0 END AS nasdaq_perf_30d
    FROM latest
)
SELECT 1 AS "Ordre", 'VIX >= 20' AS "Règle",
       CASE WHEN vix IS NULL THEN 'N/D' ELSE printf('%.2f', vix) END AS "Valeur",
       CASE WHEN vix >= 20 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS "Impact"
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 2, 'VIX >= 30',
       CASE WHEN vix IS NULL THEN 'N/D' ELSE printf('%.2f', vix) END,
       CASE WHEN vix >= 30 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 'USD_BROAD >= 122',
       CASE WHEN usd_broad IS NULL THEN 'N/D' ELSE printf('%.2f', usd_broad) END,
       CASE WHEN usd_broad >= 122 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 4, 'US10Y >= 5',
       CASE WHEN us10y IS NULL THEN 'N/D' ELSE printf('%.2f %%', us10y) END,
       CASE WHEN us10y >= 5 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 5, 'Spread 10Y-2Y < 0',
       CASE WHEN spread_10y_2y IS NULL THEN 'N/D' ELSE printf('%.3f %%', spread_10y_2y) END,
       CASE WHEN spread_10y_2y < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 6, 'WTI ou Brent >= 90',
       CASE WHEN wti IS NULL AND brent IS NULL THEN 'N/D'
            ELSE printf('WTI %.2f / Brent %.2f', wti, brent) END,
       CASE WHEN wti >= 90 OR brent >= 90 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 7, 'Performance SP500 sur 30j < 0',
       CASE WHEN sp500_perf_30d IS NULL THEN 'N/D' ELSE printf('%.2f %%', sp500_perf_30d) END,
       CASE WHEN sp500_perf_30d < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 8, 'Performance NASDAQ sur 30j < 0',
       CASE WHEN nasdaq_perf_30d IS NULL THEN 'N/D' ELSE printf('%.2f %%', nasdaq_perf_30d) END,
       CASE WHEN nasdaq_perf_30d < 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END
FROM metrics
ORDER BY "Ordre";

targets.queryText:
WITH latest_observations AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        MAX(observed_at) AS latest_observed_at
    FROM macro_series
    WHERE source = 'fred'
      AND symbol IN ('US2Y', 'US10Y', 'US30Y')
    GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.symbol = 'US2Y' THEN m.value END) AS US2Y,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.symbol = 'US10Y' THEN m.value END) AS US10Y,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.symbol = 'US30Y' THEN m.value END) AS US30Y
FROM macro_series m
JOIN latest_observations latest
  ON latest.symbol = m.symbol
 AND latest.latest_observed_at = m.observed_at
WHERE m.source = 'fred'
  AND m.symbol IN ('US2Y', 'US10Y', 'US30Y')

    us10y.value - us2y.value AS "10Y-2Y Spread"

targets.queryText:
WITH monthly_values AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        value,
        date(substr(observed_at, 1, 10)) AS observed_date
    FROM macro_series
    WHERE source = 'fred'
      AND symbol IN ('CPI', 'CORE_CPI', 'PCE', 'CORE_PCE')
),
yoy_values AS (
    SELECT
        current.symbol,
        current.observed_date,
        ((current.value / previous.value) - 1.0) * 100.0 AS yoy_percent
    FROM monthly_values current
    JOIN monthly_values previous
      ON previous.symbol = current.symbol
     AND previous.observed_date = date(current.observed_date, '-1 year')
),
latest_dates AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        MAX(observed_date) AS latest_observed_date
    FROM yoy_values
    GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN y.symbol = 'CPI' THEN y.yoy_percent END) AS "CPI YoY",
    MAX(CASE WHEN y.symbol = 'CORE_CPI' THEN y.yoy_percent END) AS "Core CPI YoY",
    MAX(CASE WHEN y.symbol = 'PCE' THEN y.yoy_percent END) AS "PCE YoY",
    MAX(CASE WHEN y.symbol = 'CORE_PCE' THEN y.yoy_percent END) AS "Core PCE YoY"
FROM yoy_values y
JOIN latest_dates latest
  ON latest.symbol = y.symbol
 AND latest.latest_observed_date = y.observed_date

targets.queryText:
WITH raw_values AS (
    SELECT
        observed_at,
        symbol,
        value
    FROM macro_series
    WHERE source = 'fred'
      AND symbol IN ('SP500', 'NASDAQ')
),
first_values AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        value AS first_value
    FROM raw_values
    WHERE observed_at IN (
        SELECT MIN(observed_at)
        FROM raw_values
        GROUP BY symbol
    )
)
SELECT
    r.observed_at AS time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.symbol = 'SP500' THEN (r.value / f.first_value) * 100.0 END) AS "SP500 base 100",
    MAX(CASE WHEN r.symbol = 'NASDAQ' THEN (r.value / f.first_value) * 100.0 END) AS "NASDAQ base 100"
FROM raw_values r
JOIN first_values f
  ON f.symbol = r.symbol
GROUP BY r.observed_at
ORDER BY r.observed_at ASC
